title: BayKompV Biotopwertliste – Biotop- und Nutzungstypen (BNT)
publisher: Bayerisches Staatsministerium für Umwelt und Verbraucherschutz (StMUV); Arbeitshilfe and BK re-mapping: Bayerisches Landesamt für Umwelt (LfU)
version: Biotopwertliste zur Anwendung der BayKompV, Stand 28.02.2014 (mit redaktionellen Änderungen vom 31.03.2014); BK sub-types re-mapped by LfU 09/2021 (mapping key 2020/2022)
license_note: Codes, names and values are facts of the official list. The list prescribes no map colours, so no colours are given.
note: value = Grundwert in Wertpunkten (WP, 0–15) = G + W + N (Seltenheit/Gefährdung, Wiederherstellbarkeit, Natürlichkeit, each 0–5); Wertstufen 0 keine, 1–5 gering, 6–10 mittel, 11–15 hoch. wp_mark * / ** = W 4 / W 5: time-lag deduction of 1–2 / 1–3 WP when the type is a target state after 25 years. wp_plus_1 = +1 WP if the stand is a § 30 / Art. 23 biotope, a BK type or an FFH habitat type. bk = column 8 of the list as transcribed (x = always one, (x) = may be one, → 2021 = LfU re-mapping 09/2021). ffh = FFH habitat types linked to the BNT (possible, not automatic). age_class = last digit of B2/B3/L/N codes (jung ≤ 25 a; mittel 26–79 a or BHD < 50 cm; alt ≥ 80 a or BHD > 50 cm). A code with a hyphenated BK sub-type (G214-GU651E) falls back to its BNT; the sub-types listed here have their own value, element and protection. protected = legal protection stated in the research; for other hyphenated codes it follows the BK type: § 30 BNatSchG / Art. 23 BayNatSchG for BS, FH, FW, GA, GC, GG, GH, GJ, GL, GN, GO, GP, GR, GT, GU, GW, GY, GZ, LL, MF, MO, MW, QF, SD, SG, SI, SU, VC, VH, VK, VU, WA, WB, WD, WE, WG, WJ, WK, WÖ, WP, WQ, WW; § 39 Abs. 5 BNatSchG / Art. 16 BayNatSchG only for GB, GX, RF, ST, UA, UE, UK, UP, UR, WH, WI, WN, WO, WX; LR… = FFH type without § 30 protection. target_allowed = false: P/X/V types usable on the impact side only (all except P1, P43, V23, V33, V5). Headings G1, P1, P43, V1, V3, V5 are not listed because the research gives no names; their codes fall back to the Obergruppe. Pass BNT codes: a bare biotope-mapping code (GU651E, RF00BK) is a different key and would fall back to an unrelated Obergruppe.
